methods.planned_coverage: All 180 archived puzzles in easy and hard modes: 360 direct/native plus numbered Play replays. Nine controlled incident paths in two modes and two text orders: 36 cases. Four invalid directions in two modes: eight cases. Archived paths are capped at eight nodes.
judgment: Uses native ReadFixture after SHA-256 and 32 MiB checks. Raw edges, raw/parsed puzzle metadata/provenance and all unselected node fields must remain exact; selected owners may append only their named aliases. No research resolver or synthetic sealed export is injected into terminal loading.

Current Parse builds no normalized text index, and Play accepts numbered options. Both owner labels and aliases must remain unresolved by the fixture graph's text resolver. Controlled Play rejects both text entries, in both orders, then wins using actual numbered options with the current score. This is explicitly zero terminal typed-alias benefit.

Every archived solution checks choices/hints/state against baseline at each hop, initial/self invalid actions, exact optimal/par/1000 score, won-repeat state, terminal Undo reopening, and rewin. Numbered Play summary and complete transcript compare exactly; hard mode must not expose hint markers.

Both owners must be absent from archived solution paths and hint-neighbor lists. Constructed research-only controls exercise actual incident edges and invalid reverse directions without creating puzzle approvals. Terminal Undo reopening is intentionally distinct from Lanț's terminal no-op.
This is candidate-fixture terminal behavior evidence once executed successfully. It does not establish sealed Source6, ordinary new owner exposure or any new terminal input feature.
